title: Meridian S01 Interior Complete
description: The S01 interior pairs the furnished H03 crew spaces with the spacecraft’s proposed compartments, from the rotating habitat to the fixed hull and aft service districts.
detail: Twenty-four named crew-cabin groups and four farm groups are joined by habitat corridors and cross-passages.
Port and starboard routes connect crew spaces, with transfer regions and an EVA airlock reference at their original scene placements.
Conceptual water, gas, cryogenic storage, fusion-power, propulsion and cooling envelopes locate proposed services.
